name: sol_basics_vi_svi_48
description: Solidity compiler bug: tuple assignment with multi-stack-slot components (nested tuples, external function pointers, dynamic calldata array references) corrupting values
question: The source file in `source` declares a pragma solidity version within the range 0.1.6 to 0.6.5 (inclusive) and contains a tuple assignment where at least one component spans multiple stack slots, such as a nested tuple, an external function pointer, or a reference to a dynamically sized calldata array, without pinning or upgrading to a patched compiler version outside that range, risking silently corrupted assigned values.
criteria: pragma solidity ^0.6.0; combined with a statement like (a, (b, c)) = f(); destructuring a nested tuple return value
pragma solidity 0.5.x; combined with (x, funcPtr) = g(); assigning an external function pointer as part of a tuple destructuring
pragma solidity 0.6.5; combined with (y, dynArr) = h(); where dynArr is a dynamically sized calldata array component of the tuple assignment
pragma solidity 0.4.x; combined with a multi-value return being destructured into a tuple containing a nested struct/tuple component
